parse_s3_path: parse an S3 path string into its bucket name and object key components
extract_bucket_from_s3: extract the bucket name from an S3 path like s3://my-bucket/my-key
extract_key_from_s3: extract the object key from an S3 path like s3://my-bucket/my-key
validate_s3_path_format: validate that a string matches the s3://bucket/key format using regex
refactor_s3_parsing: refactor the bucket_and_key_from_path function to add AWS naming rule validation
